items.title: tt-a1i/archify
items.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
items.author: tt-a1i
items.summary_zh: Archify 是一个基于 Node.js 的架构图渲染与校验系统，支持 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 OpenCode：Agent 生成类型化 JSON，Archify 再确定性编译成自包含的 HTML/SVG 图。它提供五种图类型、四套预设、深浅主题，并能在合并前用 Before/Delta/After 对比架构改动，适合把代码库直接变成可交互架构图的 AI 编程用户。
items.summary_en: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for architecture diagrams, built for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. Agents emit typed JSON IR, which Archify deterministically compiles into self-contained HTML/SVG, with five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and a Before/Delta/After comparison for reviewing changes before merge. It suits developers who want to turn a codebase or system description into an interactive diagram inside an AI coding agent.

items.summary_zh: 这篇个人评测记录作者从 Cursor 转用 Codex 大半个月的体验：作者称 Cursor 让他第一次强烈感受到 AI 编程能力，而 Codex 让他第一次觉得 AI 不只是编程助手，而是接近下一阶段形态的“超级 Agent”。适合正在选型 AI 编程工具的开发者参考。
items.summary_en: This article shares the author's experience after switching from Cursor to Codex for over two weeks. They say Cursor gave them their first strong sense of AI-assisted coding, while Codex felt like a true super-agent rather than just an assistant, closer to the next stage of AI programming. A useful read for developers choosing between AI coding tools.

It was involved in optimizing its own training and operators, forming a recursive self-improvement loop, and improving end-to-end throughput by 31.8%. API pricing is 6 CNY input and 18 CNY output per million tokens; WorkBuddy/CodeBuddy are free for two weeks.

items.summary_zh: ModelApiTester 是一个用 Rust 和 Vue 3 构建的大模型 API 测试工具，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini 格式，提供流式输出、Markdown 渲染、耗时/速度统计和多模态图片上传。共享 Rust 核心同时驱动 axum 服务器与 Tauri 桌面端，数据存 SQLite，内置 32 条分类提示词。适合经常比较模型性能或管理多个 API key 的开发者。
items.summary_en: ModelApiTester is a Rust+Vue 3 utility for testing LLM APIs, supporting OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini formats with streaming output, Markdown rendering for formulas/videos, and per-response metrics like prefill/decode time, tok/s and total tokens. A shared Rust core powers both an axum HTTP server and a Tauri desktop app, storing sessions in SQLite and bundling 32 preset prompts across 8 evaluation dimensions. It's a practical fit for developers who want to quickly benchmark model performance or organize API keys.

items.title: 1周半写64个PR、完成30%项目重构：一家成熟SaaS公司把Agent塞进研发全流程后
items.summary_zh: 日程 SaaS 公司 Calendly 公开了将 AI Agent 嵌入研发流程的实践：Agent 先审 Jira 需求、拆解任务，再并行写代码、跑测试和 QA，人类负责最终 Review 与 Merge。其 IAM 团队一周半生成 64 个 PR，完成约 30% 的大型解耦项目重构。Calendly 的结论是，工程瓶颈正从写代码转向需求对齐和判断力。
items.summary_en: Calendly, a scheduling SaaS company, detailed how it embeds AI agents across Jira, GitHub, CI and production workflows: agents review requirements, split tasks, write code in parallel, run tests and QA, with humans doing final review and merge. In its IAM team, agents generated 64 PRs in one and a half weeks and completed about 30% of a large decoupling project. The takeaway: the bottleneck is shifting from writing code to requirement alignment and judgment.

items.title: [开源软件] [MQ Studio] 把自己的 RocketMQ 客户端推倒重做成了通用消息队列客户端
items.summary_zh: MQ Studio 是作者从自家 RocketMQ 客户端 rocket-leaf 重构而来的通用消息队列客户端，当前仍只支持 RocketMQ，但架构已为 Kafka、RabbitMQ、Pulsar 预留扩展。重构前官方 dashboard 资源占用和 UI 不佳，重构后版本从 v0.1.3 退回 v0.0.1。配套开源的 Golang 管理库 rocketmq-admin-go 已被 DBX 项目作者联系接入。
items.summary_en: MQ Studio is an open-source message-queue client that began as rocket-leaf, the author's Wails3-based RocketMQ tool. After dissatisfaction with the official dashboard's resource usage and UI, the author rewrote the client, resetting the version from v0.1.3 to v0.0.1. It still only supports RocketMQ but is architecturally ready for Kafka, RabbitMQ and Pulsar; the author also open-sourced rocketmq-admin-go, a Golang admin library that interested the DBX project.

items.summary_zh: Snowflake 为 Cortex Agents 增加了一系列新能力，面向已把 Agent 投入生产的企业，解决编排、执行和治理上的运营难题。亮点包括 Async Agent API、Interrupt and Resume、Partial Access 和可视化版本管理 UI，并推出 Build Coding Agent 等公开预览功能，目标是让智能体从“能构建”走向“可规模化运营”。
items.summary_en: Snowflake is expanding Cortex Agents with new capabilities for enterprises running agents in production, targeting operational pain points in orchestration, execution, and governance. Highlights include the Async Agent API, interrupt/resume, partial access controls, and a versioning UI, along with previews like Build Coding Agent and Tool Search — aimed at moving agents from "buildable" to "operable at scale."

items.title: Token消耗减少75%，千问办公创造了新的“省钱模式”
items.summary_zh: 阿里千问8月26日发布并开源多模态MoE模型Qwen3.8-Flash：主参数125B，每Token只激活6B，输入/输出每百万Token定价0.8/2.7元。千问办公标准模式同步上线，生成速度提升约100%、Token消耗减少75%，可覆盖约95%日常任务，降低Agent使用成本。
items.summary_en: Alibaba Qwen released and open-sourced Qwen3.8-Flash on Aug 26, a multimodal MoE model with 125B main parameters and only 6B activated per token, priced at 0.8 yuan input / 2.7 yuan output per million tokens. The Qianwen Office standard mode built on it boosts single-task generation speed by about 100% and cuts average token consumption by 75%, covering roughly 95% of routine office tasks. The combination makes agent-assisted office work dramatically cheaper while keeping quality.

items.title: 下一层抽象：从UX角度思考Agentic OS的样貌
items.summary_zh: InfoQ 从 UX 角度讨论 Agentic OS：GUI 虽隐藏了复杂度，但仍要求用户把意图翻译成软件操作，例如用户只知道视频模糊，界面上却给出编码器、比特率等参数。作者认为技术用户把多年积累的电脑经验误当常识，Agent 类界面可能成为下一层抽象，让用户直接表达目标而非操作命令。
items.summary_en: This InfoQ opinion piece looks at Agentic OS from a UX perspective. GUIs already hide complexity, but they still force users to translate intent into software operations: a user sees a blurry video while the app offers codec, bitrate, and resolution settings. The author argues that power users mistake hard-won computer experience for common sense, and agent interfaces may be the next abstraction layer for expressing goals directly.

items.title: 规模化 AI 代码审查：LinkedIn 的多智能体方案
items.summary_zh: LinkedIn自建了多智能体AI代码审查平台，用多个独立审查员（不同模型与推理方式）交叉验证，并把组织策略、代码库约定和特定规则纳入定制，以降低幻觉和噪音。评估显示，在1727个PR的5230条抽样评论中，63.9%的建议被最终采纳；逻辑错误采纳率80%，并发缺陷达100%。
items.summary_en: LinkedIn built a multi-agent AI code review platform instead of bolting a generic tool onto GitHub. It combines independent reviewers using different models and reasoning methods, applies organization- and repo-specific rules, and filters noise. In an evaluation of 5,230 sampled comments across 1,727 PRs, 63.9% of suggestions were adopted; logic-error and concurrency fixes were accepted 80% and 100% of the time respectively.

The Agent Infra track now demands an AgentTeams-based design with at least three distinct agents, along with validation, code, and a demo video. Online defenses are Sept 4–6.

items.title: 智谱认领“牛来”模型，实测：“牛马”友好
items.summary_zh: 此前匿名出现在 OpenRouter 的模型 Ox Alpha 被智谱认领为 GLM-5.3-Flash。它采用 3200 亿总参数的 MoE 架构，每次仅激活约 180 亿参数，匿名测试版提供 104 万 Token 上下文，支持文本、图片和视频输入。Stripe CEO Patrick Collison 称其“非常令人印象深刻”，测试流量由国产 AI 芯片集群承载。
items.summary_en: Zhipu confirmed that Ox Alpha, the anonymous model that climbed OpenRouter's trending list, is GLM-5.3-Flash. It is a mixture-of-experts model with 320B total parameters but only about 18B active per token; the anonymous test version offered 1.04M-token context and accepted text, image, and video input. Stripe CEO Patrick Collison said it was 'very impressive,' and Zhipu said all test traffic ran on clusters built with domestic AI chips.

items.title: 谷歌落后一个时代？CEO 亲自官宣“语音转文字”模型，网友：你们看不清形势啊
items.summary_zh: 谷歌发布号称迄今最精确的语音转文本模型 Gemini 3.5 Transcribe，CEO Pichai 在 X 上宣布。它能自动清理语气词、口误和重复，理解“不，改成周三”这类自我修正，支持 85 种以上语言和实时切换，并识别最多 8 位说话人。据 Artificial Analysis，流式转录词错误率 4.0%，非流式 2.6%。
items.summary_en: Google unveiled Gemini 3.5 Transcribe, which CEO Pichai announced on X as its most accurate speech-to-text model. It cleans up fillers, mistakes, and repetitions, understands self-corrections like 'no, make it Wednesday,' supports 85+ languages with live switching, and can identify up to eight speakers. According to Artificial Analysis, word error rate is 4.0% for streaming and 2.6% for non-streaming transcription.

items.title: [宽带症候群] IPv6 有效期只有 1h
items.summary_zh: 深圳联通用户发现 OpenWRT 桥接拨号后，DHCPv6 拿到的 IPv6 有效期始终只有 1 小时，重拨换 IP 也如此；但连续观察 8 小时，地址到期后并未变化。发帖者不确定是 OpenWRT 显示问题还是联通做了短租约。对排查 IPv6 掉线/更新问题有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A Shenzhen Unicom subscriber on a bridged OpenWRT router reports that DHCPv6 IPv6 addresses always show a one-hour valid lifetime, even after redialing; over an eight-hour watch, the address didn't actually change. The poster wonders whether OpenWRT is misdisplaying the lease or the ISP is enforcing a short lease. Worth reading for anyone debugging IPv6 renewal behavior on OpenWRT.

It implements device-side rendering and interaction, and can be adapted to other agents. Handy if you want a cheaper, customizable keyboard for agent development.

items.summary_en: T-Sub installs proxy protocols on your own servers/containers with one command, centralizes subscription sources and nodes, and converts subscriptions into Base64, Clash/Mihomo, sing-box, Surge, and other formats. The deployment side keeps no SSH credentials and supports Cloudflare KV/D1 or SQLite/PostgreSQL. Good fit for self-hosted proxy users who need to manage many nodes and subscriptions.

It handles smart routing, automatic failover on rate limits, encrypted key storage, and per-key usage tracking to keep you under each free-tier cap. Developers who want one endpoint for many free model APIs will find it useful; the project is MIT-licensed and ships a Docker image.

items.summary_en: Heretic is a tool that automatically removes censorship (also called safety alignment) from transformer-based language models using directional ablation, a.k.a. abliteration, without expensive post-training. It should interest researchers and red-teamers who want a reproducible way to strip alignment and study how models behave after unalignment. Community channels include Discord, Matrix, and Hugging Face.
